title: Chrome Web Store: unlock API access
notes: Sign in to the Chrome Web Store dashboard with the publishing Google account, confirm the developer account and 2-Step Verification are fully set up, add `chrome-web-store-publisher@matthew-blode.iam.gserviceaccount.com` as a publisher account user if Chrome requires it, and record the publisher identifier needed for `CWS_PUBLISHER_ID`.

title: Chrome Web Store: complete listing and privacy tabs
notes: Use `docs/chrome-web-store/listing.md`, `docs/chrome-web-store/privacy-policy.md`, `docs/chrome-web-store/support.md`, and the generated screenshots under `store/screenshots/` plus `store/generated/` to complete the Store listing, Privacy practices, Distribution, and reviewer instruction fields, then submit the first review.
